pair.title: Connect to MyKobold
pair.intro: Sign in with the email address from your MyKobold app. Vorwerk will send you a one-time code.
pair.sent: The code was requested. Check your spam folder and use only the most recent code.
pair.note: Your email and one-time code are not stored. Homey keeps the required account connection credentials in the device store so history and maps can be refreshed. No account password is needed.
pair.add_intro: Connect your MyKobold account with an email code. You can choose your robot in the next step.
pair.repair_intro: Sign in again with the MyKobold account for this robot. Your Homey device, saved selection and Flows stay in place.
pair.email_hint: Use the same email address as in MyKobold. No account password is needed.
pair.code_requested: Check your inbox. Enter the code below.
pair.code_resent: A new code was requested. Use only the most recent email.
pair.code_hint: Use the most recent code. If the email is missing, check your spam folder or request another code after the short wait.
pair.change_email_hint: Correct your email address, then request a new code. Any remaining waiting time still applies.
pair.wait_seconds: You can request another email code in {seconds} seconds.
pair.verified: Connected. Continue to choose your robot.
pair.next_failed: The connection is ready, but the next step could not open. Press Continue to try again; you do not need another code.

settings.title: Your Kobold
settings.intro: View device information, saved cleaning history and maps, or choose an area for the next cleaning. Flows can select a different area for each job.
settings.no_devices: No robot has been added yet. Add your Kobold as a Homey device first.
settings.read_first: Read the areas from your saved MyKobold maps to choose an area.
settings.no_areas: No saved areas are available. Check your areas in MyKobold, then read them again.
settings.start_hint: Save your selection first. Cleaning only starts when you press the cleaning button.
settings.refreshed: The available areas have been updated.
settings.saved: The area selection has been saved.
settings.started: The robot has acknowledged the area cleaning start.
settings.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
settings.data_refreshed: The available device information has been refreshed.
settings.data_model_hint: A VR300 may report VR220 as its technical model.
settings.data_read_first: Refresh additional data to read the available device information.
settings.data_info_unavailable: Some additional device information could not be refreshed. Check the timestamps of the most recently read data.
settings.data_schedule_disabled_hint: The last reported schedule is disabled. Its entries do not currently start cleaning.
settings.data_schedule_cached: The schedule could not be checked now. The most recently read entries are shown.
settings.history_refreshed: The available history and map data has been refreshed.
settings.history_login_required: Sign in again with your MyKobold email code: open device settings and choose Repair. Your device and its Flows are preserved.
settings.history_cached: The history could not be checked now. The most recently read data is shown.
settings.history_unavailable: History and maps are currently unavailable.
settings.history_read_first: Refresh history and maps to read the available saved data.
settings.history_no_map_image: No map image is currently provided for these maps.
settings.history_unknown: Saved cleanings are not yet known.
settings.history_limit: Up to 20 most recently saved cleanings are shown.
settings.history_image_failed: The map image could not be displayed. Refresh the data and try again.
settings.privacy_cloud: This community app uses the Vorwerk cloud and needs internet access. Maps can show your floor plan: the selected map loads automatically when history opens, and a cleaning map when you expand its entry.
settings.privacy_storage: Your email and one-time code are not saved. Connection credentials, including account tokens, are stored privately with the Homey device. Saved area selections and map names are kept on Homey. History and opened map images are held temporarily in memory. No account password or separate analytics service is used.
settings.privacy_remove: To remove stored device credentials, delete the robot from Homey. Removing the app also removes its app settings. Copies in existing Homey backups follow your backup retention. A renewed login is available through the existing device’s Repair option.
settings.history_duration_hint: Elapsed time from start to finish, including pauses and charging interruptions.
settings.ui_intro: Choose a cleaning area or view history and maps. Further device information and the robot schedule are available below.
settings.ui_offline_hint: The displayed values come from the last successful check. Read the areas or additional data again to check the connection.
settings.ui_start_offline: The robot is currently unreachable. Read the areas again to check the connection.
settings.ui_start_station: The robot must be on the charging station for a new area job. Read the areas again afterwards to refresh its status.
settings.ui_start_pending: The start was acknowledged. Follow its progress in the Homey device view. Read available areas to refresh the status here.
settings.ui_area_intro: Reading and saving do not move the robot. A new area job starts from the charging station.
settings.ui_area_choose_hint: Choose an area from the list.
settings.ui_area_unsaved_hint: This selection has not been saved yet. Save it first to clean this area.
settings.ui_area_saved_hint: This selection is saved. The robot only starts when you press Clean this area.
settings.ui_start_unknown: The docking status is still unknown. Refresh the areas before starting a new area job.
settings.auto_map_failed: The map image could not be loaded. Try again or refresh history and maps.
settings.auto_map_no_image: No map image is available for this cleaning.
settings.support_vr200_hint: The VR200 provides basic controls, battery level and its schedule. Saved areas, maps and cleaning history are not supported by this model.
settings.support_intro: This page shows the features supported by your robots. Check their status, device information and saved schedules below.
settings.support_offline_hint: These values are from the last successful read. Refresh the device information to check the connection.
settings.support_data_read_first: Refresh the device information to read the reported mode and saved schedule.

errors.feature_unsupported: This feature is not supported by this robot model.
errors.area_selection_required: Choose an area from the area list first. Only Start area cleaning begins cleaning.
errors.maps_import_required: The saved maps need to be read again once. Open the robot’s device settings, choose Repair, and sign in with your MyKobold email code.
errors.map_discovery_failed: Sign-in succeeded, but the saved maps could not be loaded. Try signing in again later.
errors.areas_unavailable: Areas could not be loaded. Check the map in MyKobold and try again.
errors.no_areas: No cleaning areas are available. Create areas in MyKobold and refresh the list.
errors.invalid_area: Choose an area from the list.
errors.area_not_found: This area is no longer available. Refresh the areas and choose again.
errors.area_requires_dock: Area cleaning must start as a new job from the charging station. End any running or paused job first.
errors.device_not_found: The selected robot is not available.
errors.wait_before_retry: Wait at least 30 seconds before requesting another email code.
errors.no_robots: No robot was found in this MyKobold account.
errors.robot_not_found: This account does not contain the existing robot. Use the same MyKobold account as before.
errors.invalid_email: Enter a valid email address for your MyKobold account.
errors.invalid_code: The code was rejected. Request a new code and use only the most recent email.
errors.timeout: The Vorwerk cloud did not respond in time. Try again.
errors.login_failed: Sign-in failed. Check the MyKobold account, latest email code, and internet connection.
errors.unsupported_action: This action is not supported in this version.
errors.device_closed: The device is shutting down. Try again later.
errors.repair_required: The connection must be renewed. Open device settings and choose Repair.
errors.robot_unavailable: The robot is currently unreachable through the Vorwerk cloud. Check its connection in MyKobold and try again.
errors.command_failed: The command was not confirmed. Check the robot in MyKobold before sending it again.
errors.command_unavailable: The robot does not allow this command in its current state.
errors.base_not_seen: The robot has not detected its charging station and does not allow returning yet. Check the station in MyKobold.
errors.dock_not_ready: Cleaning was paused, but returning to the station is not available yet. Check the robot in MyKobold.
errors.account_login_required: Connect your MyKobold account again through the existing device’s Repair option to read history and maps.
errors.history_unavailable: History or saved maps could not be refreshed. Basic robot controls remain available.
errors.image_unavailable: The map image could not be loaded. Refresh history and try again.
errors.flow_value_unknown: This condition cannot be checked because the required value is unknown. Refresh the relevant data and try again.

warnings.nav_floorplan_load_fail: The saved map could not be loaded
warnings.nav_floorplan_localization_fail: The robot could not locate itself on the map
warnings.nav_floorplan_not_created: No suitable saved map is available
warnings.ui_alert_battery_chargebasecommerr: Check the battery and charging contacts
